liebermann.description_de: 'Johannis Brompton Jorevallensis chronicon': Hss. Cambridge Corpus College 96 (Brco) und British Museum Tiberius C XIII (Brti); ed. Twysden
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, British Library, Cotton MS Tiberius C.xiii (a manuscript of the Brompton chronicle)
liebermann.date: probably second half of the 14th century; Brco c. 1425; Brti 15th century
liebermann.laws: Quadr, Ine, Af, AGu, EGu, I Ew, II Ew, I As, II As, III As, IV As, V As, VI As, Episc, Norðleod, Mirce, Að, Had, Blas, Forf, Hu, Ordal, I Em, II Em, III Em, Wif, II Eg, III Eg, I Atr, II Atr, III Atr, IV Atr, VII Atr, Pax, Wal, Iudex, I Cn, II Cn, ECf retr, Wl lad, CHn cor
liebermann.notes: A large compilation of English history to 1199, misnamed after John Brompton, abbot of Jervaulx, from a note in one copy; the compiler used a late-recension Quadripartitus, rearranging it chronologically. Its two independent manuscripts Brco and Brti were printed by Twysden, whose edition Liebermann follows; extracts are in Cambridge Corpus 348 and Harley 362.
